title: One underlying. Four instruments. One clear answer.
returns_desc: Select the asset, investment horizon, and capital. The tool normalises all instruments to the same notional exposure.
exposure_desc: Spreads, swap rates, commissions, theta decay, rollover costs and broker fees are applied from official fee schedules.
flow_desc: Output: net return per instrument, cost drag in euros, and a ranked comparison. Broker suggestions where relevant.
